create_polynomial_weight_algorithm: create a PolynomialWeightAlgorithm instance for mean-field game regret minimization with configurable eta and policies
run_polynomial_weight_step: run a single step of the PolynomialWeightAlgorithm to compute rewards and update weights
get_nu_distribution: get the current policy distribution nu from the PolynomialWeightAlgorithm regret minimizer
reset_polynomial_weight_algorithm: reset the PolynomialWeightAlgorithm with new policies and reinitialize internal weights
compute_optimal_eta: compute the optimal learning rate eta for the PolynomialWeightAlgorithm based on regret_steps_per_step
